info.name: FamilyRoots Super App API
info.description:
Super-app API collection, grouped by domain.

| Folder | Prefix | Modules |
|---|---|---|
| **0. Meta** | — | Root info, error examples |
| **1. Core** | `core_` | Auth, Health, Logs, Media |
| **2. Family Roots** | `fr_` | Persons/Silsilah, Events, Memoriam, Dashboard, Map |
| **3. Family Core** | `fc_` | (placeholder) Dokumen, Health Tracker, Family Calendar |
| **4. Money Track** | `mt_` | (placeholder) Budget, Wishlist, Utang/Piutang |
| **5. Household** | `hh_` | (placeholder) Inventory, Resep, Daftar Belanja |

**Flow:** Core → Auth → Login → Family Roots → Persons / Events / Memoriam.

**Error format:** `{ "error": { "code", "message" } }`

item.name: 0. Meta
item.description: Info umum & contoh error (bukan domain produk).

item.name: 1. Core (core_)
item.description:
Shared / Auth — tabel `core_*`.

Modules: Health, Auth, Logs, Media.

API paths: `/api/v1/{health,auth,logs,media}`.

item.name: Auth
item.description: Login dengan kode keluarga `{ABBREV}{DDMMYY}` dari **fullName** (bukan nickname). Contoh: `MIA210399`, `MR170845`, `BA200175`.

request.description:
**Public** — login Mulyono Raka (demo-mr).

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| code | string | yes |
| remember | boolean | no (default false) |

**200 OK**
```json
{
  "data": {
    "accessToken": "...",
    "refreshToken": "...",
    "expiresIn": 3600,
    "person": {
      "id": 95,
      "fullName": "Mulyono Raka",
      "nickname": null,
      "gender": "male",
      "birthDate": "1945-08-17",
      "status": "alive",
      "photoUrl": null,
      "isMarried": false,
      "isLegal": true,
      "spouseIds": [],
      "allowedFocusPersons": [
        {
          "id": 95,
          "fullName": "Mulyono Raka",
          "nickname": null,
          "gender": "male",
          "photoUrl": null,
          "relation": "self"
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**Errors:**
- 400 `CODE_REQUIRED`
- 400 `CODE_INVALID_FORMAT`
- 401 `CODE_NOT_FOUND`
- 429 `TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS`
Expect **400** `CODE_INVALID_FORMAT`
Expect **401** `CODE_NOT_FOUND` (sama untuk deceased)

**Auth required** — includes `readFocusPersonId`, `allowedFocusPersonIds`, `allowedFocusPersons` (self + spouse for navbar switcher), `spouseIds`, `isMarried`, `isLegal`.

**401** `UNAUTHORIZED` tanpa/invalid token
**200 OK** `{ "data": { "options": { "readFocusPersonId": "84" } } }`
Toggle perspektif Pasangan — setelah ini GET /events, /persons/map, dll. tanpa query focusPersonId.

**Public** — rotate refresh token.

**200 OK** `{ accessToken, refreshToken, expiresIn }`

**401** `REFRESH_TOKEN_INVALID`

**Auth required** — revoke refresh token.

**200 OK** `{ "data": { "loggedOut": true } }`
**201 Created** `{ "data": { "recorded": true } }`
Expect **400** `INVALID_LOG_EVENT`

item.name: Media
item.description:
Eager upload foto. Storage dipisah: `events/` · `memoriam/` · `persons/`. Lihat docs/requests/from-fe/done/MEDIA-UPLOAD-API.md.

Flow: Upload → preview → Delete/Cleanup → submit entity dengan `mediaIds` / `mediaId`.

request.description: File → `uploads/media/events/`. Test script set `mediaId` + `eventMediaId`.
File → `uploads/media/memoriam/`. Test script set `memoriamMediaId`.
File → `uploads/media/persons/`. Test script set `personMediaId`. Submit ke Persons Create/Update dengan `mediaId`.
**204** — hanya owner + status pending.
**200** `{ deletedIds, skippedIds }` — panggil saat batal/tutup modal.
Expect **204** with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` when origin is listed in `CORS_ORIGINS`.

item.name: 2. Family Roots (fr_)
item.description:

Modules: Silsilah (Persons), Peta Alamat, Acara & Gathering (Events), Memoriam, Dashboard.

API paths: `/api/v1/{persons,events,memoriam,dashboard}`.
